sources.title: Central Bank: Monetary Policy Review No. 3 of 2026, press presentation, 26 May 2026 (OPR 8.75%, inflation target 5%, AWDR 6.86% and 1-year bill 8.49% as of April-May 2026)
Not from a primary source: an assumption for the pack's reviewer to replace (see README)

inflation.basis: The Central Bank's inflation target (CCPI, y-o-y), used as the long-run rate

asset_classes.label: Rupee cash and fixed deposits
asset_classes.basis: Return: the deposit rate (6.86%) less the 5% target. Volatility: an assumption.

asset_classes.label: Government securities (treasury bills and bonds)
asset_classes.basis: Return: the 1-year treasury bill yield (8.49%) less the 5% target. Volatility: an assumption for a short-to-medium duration mix.

asset_classes.label: Local listed equities
asset_classes.basis: Assumption: no primary source publishes an expected return; the exchange's own index history was not obtained.

asset_classes.label: Global equities, held in US dollars
asset_classes.basis: Assumption in US-dollar real terms; the rupee's move against the dollar is not modelled here.
